name: Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan
nameAr: معاوية بن أبي سفيان صخر بن حرب بن أمية بن عبد شمس الأموي القرشي رضي الله عنه
bornNote: Born five years before the Prophet's mission on the best-known report (others say six, or thirteen), so about 18 years before the hijra
diedNote: Rajab 60 AH in Damascus, approaching eighty; also said 59

taqrib.ar: الخليفة، صحابي أسلم قبل الفتح وكتب الوحي، ومات في رجب سنة ستين وقد قارب الثمانين
taqrib.en: The caliph. A Companion who accepted Islam before the conquest of Makkah and served as a scribe of the revelation; he died in Rajab 60 AH approaching eighty.

role: Companion; scribe of the revelation; governor of Syria for Umar and Uthman, then caliph (41–60 AH)

students.name: Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf
students.nameAr: حميد بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف

students.name: Jarir ibn Abdullah
students.source: reciprocal of the entry in jarir-ibn-abdullah-al-bajali's record (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib)

flags.label: Date of his Islam
flags.detail: Al-Mizzi: he and his father were among those who accepted Islam at the conquest of Makkah; it is also said he accepted Islam at the time of al-Hudaybiya and concealed it. Ibn Hajar's Taqrib says 'before the conquest'.

bio: Son of Abu Sufyan and Hind bint Utba, brother of the Prophet's wife Umm Habiba, and one of the scribes who wrote down the revelation. Umar appointed him over Syria after his brother Yazid, Uthman kept him there, and after the first civil war he became caliph and ruled from Damascus for twenty years. He delivered this hadith from the pulpit, which is how Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman heard it.
